messages:
jules: Opening a focused PR to add a 'quick migration' appendix for Dedicated provisioning. It will cover tenant label changes, terraform snippets, and a short autoscale FAQ. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/handbook/pull/614

nina: Nice. Can we make the terraform example explicit about reserved vs shared pool attributes? I've seen confusion about `preemption_policy` defaults.

jules: Good call. I'll include two tiny TF blocks and call out the default preemption behavior.

platform-bot: Link-checker: /handbook/dedicated/old-tenant-labels -> 404. Suggested replacement: /handbook/dedicated/migrations/tenant-labels-2026

els: Also we should add a short code sample showing SDK v2 JS usage for setting scale_policy and isolation_labels. Customers copy-paste that a lot.

nina: I'll draft the JS snippet. Also add a one-line rwctl command to inspect pool status after provisioning.

eli: Draft JS snippet: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.RW_KEY);
await client.reservedPools.create({
  name: 'batch-pool',
  gpu_type: 'a10g',
  scale_policy: { min_replicas: 1, max_replicas: 6, mode: 'burst' },
  isolation_labels: { tenant_id: 'acme' }
});
```

jules: Perfect. For the autoscale FAQ can we include: what happens during preemption, how fallback routing picks a compatible model, and cost impacts if fallback occurs? Keep it short.

sre-ops: I'll add the behavioral bullets: 1) preemption targets opportunistic jobs first, 2) critical reserved requests get fallback to shared if enabled, 3) fallback increases latency and token cost. Also will clarify SLA: Reserved capacity: 99.9% control-plane availability; latency SLOs are P95/P99 shapes, see metrics link.

docs-qa: Quick QA checklist request: include commands/test steps to confirm isolation is enforced (list tenants, run sample inference from different tenant, verify metrics). I can write the steps.

nina: Added a short terraform snippet for reserved pool: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "reports" {
  name = "reports-pool"
  gpu_type = "a10g"
  capacity = 3
  preemption_policy = "opportunistic"
  isolation_labels = { tenant_id = "reports-tenant" }
}
```

jules: Great. One more: migration note — mention that if a tenant was previously labeled with `owner` key, `rwctl tenant migrate-labels --from owner --to tenant_id` will help migrate.

platform-bot: CI: build passed (staging). Link-checker: 0 broken links. Spellcheck: suggested change 'behavour' -> 'behavior'.

eli: LGTM. I'll approve the PR once docs-qa confirms the test steps.

jules: Thanks all — merging after docs-qa post-check. Marking thread for follow-up to ensure the metrics link points to the canonical SRE dashboard.
